# What blocks manual-wheelchair trips: frederick

**Internal use only** while this region uses unlicensed data (AGENTS.md rule 7). Generated by `tools/blocked_trips/blocked_trips.py` from `pf crux`'s trip sample; do not hand-edit.

Trips with a manual-wheelchair route (step-free, 8.33%, allow likely): **131 of 276 (47.5%)**. Criterion 4 needs 50%: 7 more trips.

## Worklist

The **13 places** in `worklist.csv` would open the 7 trips the bar needs, *if every one turned out to have a usable ramp*: an upper bound. 5 are inside the city line. Measured slopes are never on the list. Opened per places checked: 10: 5, 20: 13, 30: 17, 40: 20, 50: 24, 75: 36, 100: 40, 257: 73.
